info.title: Conversational AI Agent API Overview
info.description:
This article introduces the basic information of Agora conversational agent service RESTful API.

## Data format

The `Content-Type` request header of all HTTP requests is `application/json`. All request and response content are formatted as JSON.

get.description:
After the session with the agent ends, call this interface to query the dialogue round information of this session, including the start information, end information, and performance indicators of each dialogue round.
> Only supports querying sessions within 7 days.

parameters.description:
When sending an HTTP request, you need to choose one of the following authentication methods:
  1. ** (Recommended) Use RTC Token**: Fill in the `Authorization` field with the RTC Token used by the Agora conversational AI engine project. You can choose the following methods to obtain Token:
    • In the test environment, you can generate a temporary Token (valid for 24 hours) for your project from [Shengwang Console](https://console.shengwang.cn/).
    • In a production environment, you can refer to [Using Token Authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/android/basic-features/token-authentication) to deploy the Token server to generate Token.
    Example of passing parameters: `Authorization: agora token="007abcxxxxxxx123"`
  2. **Use Basic Auth**: Refer to [Implementing HTTP security authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/user-guides/http-basic-auth#Use-http-basic authentication) to generate the Base64-encoded `Authorization` field.
    Parameter passing example: `Authorization: Basic NDI1OTQ3N2I4MzYy...YwZjA=`
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Agent instance ID, which is the unique identifier of the agent. After calling [POST to create a conversational agent](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent) successfully, it will be obtained in the response package body.
parameters.name: agentId

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

turn_id.description: Conversation turn ID, starting from 1 and increasing.

start_at.description: Start timestamp, UTC time in milliseconds.

type.description:
Start type:
- `voice_input`: Started by user voice input.
- `greeting`: starts when the agent broadcasts a greeting.
- `silence_timeout`: Started due to agent silence timeout.
- `api_speak`: Started by calling the [Report custom information](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/agent-speak) interface to broadcast information.

metadata.description: Start appending metadata, including different fields depending on the `type` field.
metadata.title: metadata

interrupt_duration_ms.description: Vocal duration threshold (ms) when the agent is idle or listening.

greeting_nth.description: Number of times the greeting has been played.

action.description:
- `speak`: broadcast the silent prompt content.
- `think`: Append the silent prompt content to the end of the context and pass it to LLM.

oneOf.title: api_speak
oneOf.description: Broadcast custom information with additional metadata.

transport.description:
Transport protocol:
- `http`: HTTP protocol.
- `rtm`: transmitted via RTM Presence channel.

end_at.description: End timestamp, UTC time in milliseconds.

type.description:
Round end type:
- `ok`: End normally.
- `interrupted`: interrupted.
- `ignored`: ignored.
- `error`: execution error.

metadata.description: End additional metadata, containing different fields depending on the `type` field.
metadata.title: metadata

caused_by.description:
Reason for round interruption:
- `start_of_speech`: starts a new speech request.
- `api_speak`: Interrupted due to calling the [Report custom information](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/agent-speak) interface to report information.
- `api_interrupt`: Interrupted by calling the [Interrupt Agent](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/agent-interrupt) interface.
- `api_leave`: Interrupted by calling the [Stop Conversational Agent](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/leave-channel) interface to leave the channel.

transport.description:
Transport protocol (returned when `caused_by` is `api_speak` or `api_interrupt`):
- `http`: HTTP protocol.
- `rtm`: transmitted via RTM Presence channel.

caused_by.description:
Reasons for round ignoring:
- `semantic`: After turning on the graceful interruption function (`turn_detection.config.end_of_speech.mode` is `semantic`) when [creating a conversational agent](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent), it is ignored because the semantic rules determine that no response is required.
- `keywords`: After turning on the keyword-based dialogue start detection function (`turn_detection.config.start_of_speech.mode` is `keywords`) when [Creating a conversational agent](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent), the round of dialogue is ignored due to missing keywords in the round start detection.
- `disable`: Because the dialogue round detection function is set to uninterruptible, this round of dialogue is ignored.

reason.description:
Error type, may contain the following values:
- `LLM_REQUEST_ERR`: LLM request error.
- `INTERNAL_ERR`: Internal error.

segmented_latency_ms.description: List of segment latency metric details.

name.description: Delay module name. Different delay modules are returned depending on the LLM input mode set when [Creating Conversational Agent](/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent).
name.title: modality

oneOf.title: text
oneOf.description:
When the LLM input mode is `text`, the returned delay module is:
  - `algorithm_processing`: algorithm processing delay.
  - `asr_ttlw`: The ttlw (Time To Last Word) indicator of the ASR module, which represents the delay time from detecting the end of the user's speaking to ASR outputting the last word.
  - `llm_ttft`: The ttft (Time To First Token) indicator of the LLM module, which represents the delay time from the end of the user speaking to the time when LLM outputs the first token.
  - `llm_ftfs`: The ftfs (First token To First Sentence) indicator of the LLM module, indicating the delay time from LLM outputting the first token to outputting the first complete sentence.
  - `tts_ttfb`: The ttfb (Time To First Byte) indicator of the TTS module, which represents the delay time from when the TTS module receives a text request to when TTS outputs the first audio byte.
  - `transport`: network transmission delay (ms). Currently, this field is not returned when the user uses the RTC Web SDK.

oneOf.title: audio
oneOf.description:
When the LLM input mode is `audio`, the returned delay module is:
  - `algorithm_processing`: algorithm processing delay.
  - `asr_ttlw`: The ttlw (Time To Last Word) indicator of the ASR module, which represents the delay time from detecting the end of the user's speaking to ASR outputting the last word.
  - `llm_ttfa`: The ttfa (Time To First Audio to First Byte) indicator of the LLM module, which represents the delay time from the end of the user speaking to the LLM outputting the first audio byte to the TTS module receiving the first audio byte.
  - `transport`: network transmission delay (ms). Currently, this field is not returned when the user uses the RTC Web SDK.

200.description:
- If the returned status code is `200`, the request is successful. The response body contains the results of this request.
- If the returned status code is not `200`, it means the request failed. The response package body contains the error category and description. You can refer to [Response Status Code](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/api/response-code) to learn about possible causes.
